description: Fixture for direct messages on phone-chat with the social theme (README_scenario_design.md "Direct messages (social theme)"). A Friendface messaging app in inventory and on a desk laptop, with an app title, accent, no status bar, and two contacts: Priya the neighbour (an ordinary ink chat with a timed follow-up) and Dom the club secretary (a judged guest-list chat via the pretext mechanic). Both contacts show a handle and a View profile link into an OSINT social profile. Not a mission.
